description: Iteration 1 (no feedback yet), corrected: moto distribution split into normal, slow and space-seeking (custom1) riders; cars as one standard archetype (custom2 car seekers dropped, no queue_space_seeking option exists for them on this site); one violator archetype for illegal lefts. Rules sized from the observation targets.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant cars: near-default car following; low impatience keeps M3/share/car (0.004) and M2/early/car (0.011) small, M1/car headway left at SUMO-typical values until feedback shows a gap.

Typical riders filter and compact in the queue: small minGapLat and compact alignment push M4/overshoot_share (0.62) and M5/moto_density (0.052 veh/m2) up, and shorten M5/length (15.8 m) and M1/moto headway (0.296 s).
Slow riders in the lane centre: lower speedFactor raises the M6/approach times towards the observed means (e.g. s/moto 35.7 s) without changing the other behaviours.
Pushy riders that may seek space: they provide the sidewalk riders for M10a (0.56 veh/cycle) and the right_lane/wrong_lane-type space seeking targeted by M8/moto (0.249) where those options exist.
Illegal-left riders from HDT_N/HDT_S: default jmTimegapMinor 1.0 s as a neutral start for M7a (5.6 waiters) and M7b (5.5 s clear lag); no feedback yet to move it.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto observed 0.13 within the last 10 s of red; p 0.15 on front-row riders (within the 4-10 s lead time) targets that share and M2/first_delay (2.8 s).
M3/share/moto observed 0.098 and var_to_mean 1.14 (mild clustering): low base probability plus a small swarm increment, capped, aims at about 3.9 violations per cycle without over-dispersion.

Option probabilities follow the observed F2 targets (wrong_lane 0.19-0.23, sidewalk 0.009-0.049, right_lane 0.01-0.02 at q below 40 m); on this site wrong_lane and right_lane are redistributed and p_sidewalk > 0 keeps the rule executable for custom1 riders (M10a 0.56 veh/cycle); q 10 m is under the mean queue at green onset (15.8 m, M5/length) so the draw fires in observed queues; t_g_s 7 s is the green check from the prompt.
M7a/release_time is 2.78 s and M7b/clear_lag 5.46 s after the opposing green ends; a mid-range extra hold of 1.5 s on top of SUMO's native release is a neutral start before feedback.
Slow riders keep the lane centre (offset 0), which supports the M6/approach moto times and M4/lat_moto without extra lateral shift; no measured offset is given so the neutral value is kept.
